newsitem.title: USA: N.J. Turnpike sets event to lure back truckers.
newsitem.headline: N.J. Turnpike sets event to lure back truckers.

text.p: The New Jersey Turnpike Authority said Friday it would sponsor a one-day conference next week to convince commercial truckers to increase their use of the highway.
Entitled "Driving the Pike Again," the conference will highlight new projects and technologies being planned for the Turnpike, which connects Philadelphia to New York City.

"The purpose of this conference is to allow the authority to meet with and listen to its commercial customers," Turnpike Authority Chairman Frank McDermott said. "We will continue to make improvements with the goal of attracting commercial traffic back to the road."

Commercial vehicles represent 13 percent of total volume on the Turnpike. Raising that rate, which has declined in recent years following toll hikes, is a central element of the authority's three-year toll stabilization plan announced last December.
The conference is set for Oct 30 in Edison, N.J.
